text: Coffee with Tanvi this morning. Her sister Aditi is pregnant again, due around March 9th. Tanvi's thrilled but says Aditi's had awful morning sickness this time. Remind me to text Aditi on Friday.

Long catch-up with Reggie and Ebony. They've finally set a date, wedding is June 3rd next year at her parents' place. Reggie's already stressing about the speech. Ebony wants a small do, maybe 60 people, but his mum has other ideas. Her brother Samir is flying back from Dubai for it and they've asked him to officiate, which he's thrilled about. Engagement photos are booked for May 20 at golden hour.

Rang Dorota. Her dad's knee replacement got moved to Nov 12 at 8am. She's taking the whole week off to look after him. He's nervous, hasn't been in hospital since the 90s. Her brother Nikolai can't get leave so it's all on her, and she's still recovering from her own back thing. Remind me to text Dorota on the 11th in the evening.

spans.text: recovering from her own back thing

text: Matteo and Sofia's 10th anniversary is 11/4. He wants to surprise her with a weekend in Lisbon but can't get the time off. Don't forget to ask him tomorrow evening if he sorted it.

Bumped into Samir at the shops. Baby Zara arrived last Tuesday, 7lb 2oz, everyone doing well. He looked absolutely shattered but happy. Need to get a card and something small for the baby before Sunday.

spans.text: get a card and something small for the baby

text: Mai called. The christening's been called off, the vicar's ill and they can't get another date. She's gutted, her mum had already flown in from Hanoi for it.
Imogen had her scan yesterday afternoon, all looks fine. It's a boy! Her partner Chidi cried apparently lol. They're doing a little gender reveal thing on the 22nd at 4.
Pick up prescription tomorrow morning, then dentist at 2:30.

Kofi's back home after the gallbladder op. Still sore, can't drive for 2 weeks. His wife Valentina is doing all the school runs and is pretty worn out. Remind me to drop round a lasagne Thursday after work.

Saskia got engaged!! Tunde proposed on a beach in Crete on Sept 28. The ring was his grandmother's. Engagement party's probably December, she'll confirm. They're thinking of a wedding in Zimbabwe so Tunde's grandparents can come, which means saving like mad. Saskia also mentioned her sister Aditi just got back from her honeymoon in Bali, so it's been a big year for them.

Chat with Nikolai at the gym. He's training for the Manchester half in April. Hates running in the rain but loves the long Sunday ones. Also really into fermenting lately, has about six jars of kimchi on the go.
Aurelio - allergic to shellfish, doesn't drink, massive Juventus fan. Wife is Manon, two kids both under 5. Lives out near the reservoir.
Ask Pedro how his mum's cataract surgery went.

spans.text: Ask Pedro how his mum's cataract surgery went

text: Lunch with Zoe and Svetlana. Svetlana's 6 months along now, due Jan 20th, and moving house in December which is insane. Zoe's throwing her a baby shower on 12/7 at 1pm. I'm bringing cupcakes. Must order them by the 1st.
Dafydd's in hospital again, chest infection. Should be out by the weekend. His daughter Ayesha says he's being grumpy with the nurses which is apparently a good sign.
Omar and his wife renew their vows on Aug 9, 25 years married. He mentioned she's been dropping hints about a pearl necklace. Michael and I might chip in together.

spans.text: dropping hints about a pearl necklace

text: Tendai's wedding is off. She and Duc split up after 4 years. She seems okay, keeping busy with work, but her flatmate says she's not sleeping much.
Note to self: book my flu jab, and the car MOT is due 10/30.

Spoke to Noah. His partner Sophie had the baby early, May 14 at 3:40am, a little girl called Rose. Both in NICU for a few days but stable. Noah sounded wiped. Text him Wednesday to see how they're doing, and don't send flowers, the ward doesn't allow them.
Ali's appointment with the consultant is Thursday at 11. He's worried it's his heart again. I'm driving him there.
Quick one - Valentina loves orchids and lemon drizzle cake. Would love a decent cookbook for her birthday.

Catch-up w Ebony. Her brother Michael proposed to his gf at the weekend, she said yes obviously. Ebony might be bridesmaid? Not sure how that works lol. She also starts physio for her shoulder on the 8th.
Chidi's surgery went fine yesterday. He's on crutches for six weeks and really bored already. Remind me to send him that list of series and maybe pop round next Saturday afternoon.

spans.text: send him that list of series

text: Matteo said Sofia's pregnant!! Early days, 10 weeks, they're not telling anyone till after the 12 week scan on Nov 3rd. Keep it quiet.
Dinner at Samir's. Their cat Pistachio is home from the vet, had three teeth out on Monday. Samir's mum is visiting from Lahore until the 18th. She makes incredible biryani.
Sophie and Tunde got married on the 5th at the registry office, no guests, just told everyone after!! Party for friends on Oct 26 at 7pm at the Red Lion. We're going.
Imogen's grandad passed away Tuesday night. Funeral's 11/2 at 10am. She's holding up but very quiet. Send her a message tonight.
Quick hello with Reggie on the phone, nothing much to report.
Dorota's dad is home!! Op went well, he's walking with a frame already. She said thanks for the flowers. Next check-up is Dec 1st at 9:15.

Manon - 3rd baby due June 12th. Finds out the sex at the 20 week scan, end of Feb. Her husband Kofi wants a boy this time, they've got two girls. Remind me to get her something for the bump, she's always cold, maybe a nice blanket.

spans.text: get her something for the bump

text: Long chat with Aurelio about his parents' 50th anniversary on April 19. The whole family's flying to Naples for it and he's organising a big lunch on the Sunday at noon. His sister Valentina is doing the cake. He's stressed about the seating plan already because two of his uncles don't speak.
Pedro's daughter Zoe has her tonsils out on the 14th at 7am, first op ever, she's terrified. He's taking the day off. Ask him that evening how she got on.
Remind me to ask Tanvi about her IVF appointment on Monday, she said the 9:30 one. Don't bring it up in front of her in-laws.

text: Svetlana loves crosswords, gardening and old Hitchcock films. Can't stand cats.

Saw Duc and Mai at the market. Their son Noah starts nursery next month and Mai's back at work part time from Nov 4. Duc's mum is moving in to help out. Their dog Pho is enormous now. Mai said Noah's sleeping through finally, but Duc's been struggling with the night feeds anyway because of his shifts at the hospital. They want to do a 2nd birthday thing for him in January, probably at his mum's.
Ebony's sister had twins!! Born 9/30, two boys, both tiny but healthy. Ebony's flying to Atlanta next Thursday morning to help out for a fortnight.

Christening for Kofi Mensah and Valentina's little one is Sunday Nov 16 at 11, St Mary's then lunch at theirs. I'm a godparent!!! Must buy a proper gift, silver something? Ask Val what they've already got.

Gym, then grocery run, then laundry. Call the bank about the mortgage letter before 5 tomorrow.
